name: Maine
description: Follow Maine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Democratic Senate Candidates in Maine Denounce Deadly ICE Shooting
changes.summary: The killing of a man in Biddeford quickly became an issue in the Senate race, with Democrats aiming to tie Senator Susan Collins to President Trump’s immigration crackdown.

changes.title: 1 person killed in Maine shooting involving ICE, state house speaker says
changes.summary: A person was shot and killed in Maine involving ICE, the state.

changes.title: Graham Platner's voters figure out what's next as candidates vie for their support
changes.summary: voters are still grappling with Democratic Senate candidate Graham Platner's dramatic departure from the race.

changes.title: ICE shot and killed a Colombian man in Maine. This is the 2nd time in a week the agency used deadly force
changes.summary: Bystander video taken after the shooting showed agents trying to slow a white sedan that was driving in circles in an intersection in Biddeford, southwest of Portland.

changes.title: ICE Agent Kills Person in Vehicle in Biddeford, Maine, State Officials Say
changes.summary: The killing occurred in Biddeford, about 20 miles south of Portland. The Trump administration has stepped up immigration enforcement nationally in recent weeks.

changes.title: Tamara Keith and Amy Walter on Lindsey Graham's passing
changes.summary: NPR's Tamara Keith and Amy Walter of the Cook Political Report with Amy Walter join Geoff Bennett to discuss the latest political news, including what the passing of Sen. Lindsey Graham means for South Carolina and the Senate, Sen. Mitch McConnell's health and Democrats scrambling to replace Graham Platner in the Maine.

changes.title: Person reportedly shot and killed in incident involving ICE agent in Maine
changes.summary: A person has been reportedly shot and killed in an incident involving an ICE agent in Biddeford, Maine. NBC News' Julia Ainsley has early details on the incident and how local and federal authorities are responding.

changes.title: ICE agent shoots and kills motorist in Maine, senator says
changes.summary: Sen. Angus King said he told Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin that he wanted a transparent investigation into the shooting.

changes.title: Maine Democrats scramble to select replacement for Platner in Senate race
changes.summary: Democrats now have a process for choosing a replacement for Senate candidate Graham Platner. But voters are still reeling from his fall.

changes.title: Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows on her bid to replace Platner in Senate race
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows about her run to replace Graham Platner in the Maine Senate race.
